The Nine Arch Bridge view

Watch the trains cross the clouds

Built in the British colonial era with stone and brick, the Nine Arch Bridge is a marvel of engineering and heritage. From Rainbow Sky’s scenic viewpoints you can watch trains pass over this historic landmark amid lush hills — and it’s just minutes away on foot.

Ella highlights

Our Ella guide

The iconic landmarks and hidden gems around the cottage.

The colonial-era stone viaduct in the tea forest — time your visit with the train and listen to the valley echo.

Ella’s most popular hike for couples, families and first-timers: tea plantations, village paths and a short stair climb to panoramic ridgelines. Go before sunrise or late afternoon.

One of Sri Lanka’s widest waterfalls, a short drive down the Ella–Wellawaya road.

A relaxed, backpacker-friendly town of artisan coffee, Sri Lankan meals and live music — then hop on the scenic train, rent a scooter or hire a tuk-tuk.

A peaceful retreat in Kumbalwela for meditation and quiet reflection. Dress modestly and visit in the morning or late afternoon.
